items: Read the problem statement carefully and ask clarifying questions if needed
Plan your solution before starting to code
Use a version control system to track changes and collaborate with others
Test and debug your code thoroughly before submitting

steps.title: Step 1: Read and Understand the Problem
steps.body: Take your time to read the problem statement carefully and make sure you understand what is being asked. Ask clarifying questions if you are unsure about any part of the problem.

steps.title: Step 2: Plan Your Solution
steps.body: Before starting to code, take some time to plan your solution. Break down the problem into smaller parts and think about how you can solve each part.

steps.title: Step 3: Implement Your Solution
steps.body: Once you have a plan, start implementing your solution. Use a version control system to track changes and collaborate with others.

steps.title: Step 4: Test and Debug
steps.body: After implementing your solution, test and debug your code thoroughly. Make sure it works as expected and fix any bugs you find.

items.q: What is the purpose of take home assignments?
items.a: The purpose of take home assignments is to assess your coding skills and problem-solving abilities in a more realistic setting.

items.q: How long should I spend on a take home assignment?
items.a: The time limit for a take home assignment varies, but it is usually several days or a week. Make sure to plan your time wisely and allocate enough time for each part of the assignment.

items.q: Can I ask for help during a take home assignment?
items.a: It depends on the specific assignment and the company's policies. Some companies may allow you to ask for help or clarification, while others may not. Make sure to read the instructions carefully and ask questions if you are unsure.
